help.title: Help and frequently asked questions
help.description: Finding the part for your appliance, checking that it fits, and what this demonstration site is.

sections.heading: How do I find the part for my appliance?
paragraphs: Type your appliance’s model number into the search box at the top of every page. If it matches a model exactly, you land on that model’s page, which lists the parts that fit it; otherwise, the search lists the closest models and parts.

sections.heading: Where is my appliance’s model number?
paragraphs: On its rating plate, a label often found around the door frame, on the back or underneath the appliance.

sections.heading: How do I know whether a part fits?
paragraphs: Each product page lists the compatible models, up to a million for a single part. The first thousand are shown on the page, the rest on numbered pages.

sections.heading: Are the products and prices real?
paragraphs: No. The products, brands, references and prices are fictitious: Sekoya Parts is a demonstration site.

sections.heading: Can I place an order?
paragraphs: No. No real order can be placed: nothing is paid for or delivered.

sections.heading: Which languages is the site in?
paragraphs: Ten: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Polish, Swedish and Danish. The language switch at the top of the pages leads to the same page in another language.

delivery.title: Delivery and returns
delivery.description: Sekoya Parts is a demonstration shop: no order is ever shipped.

sections.heading: No delivery
paragraphs: Sekoya Parts is a demonstration shop: no order is shipped, and no return is possible, since nothing is sold.

sections.heading: Delivery times and costs shown
paragraphs: The delivery times, shipping costs and free-delivery thresholds the site shows are fictitious examples that make the demonstration realistic.

paragraphs: The site is hosted by {hostName}, {hostAddress}. Its code runs in Frankfurt (Germany).

sections.heading: A demonstration site
paragraphs: Sekoya Parts is a portfolio project: it shows that a very large spare-parts catalog, and a shop around it, can stay fast. The products, brands, references and prices are fictitious, and no sale is made on this site.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The site’s name, logo, texts and images were created for this project. Its source code can be read on GitHub, but its licence grants no right to reuse it.

terms.title: Terms of sale (demonstration)
terms.description: The terms of the Sekoya Parts demonstration shop, where nothing is sold.

sections.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: These terms describe the Sekoya Parts demonstration shop. They have no contractual value: no sale is made on this site.

sections.heading: Products and prices
paragraphs: The products, their references and their prices, shown in euros, are fictitious. They show how a very large catalog behaves.

sections.heading: Orders and payment
paragraphs: The site takes no real order: no payment is requested or taken, no card details are asked for, and nothing is delivered.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For any question about this project, write to the publisher, whose details are in the legal notice.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: The data the Sekoya Parts site receives, what it does with it, and who it passes it to.

sections.heading: In short
paragraphs: The site uses no audience measurement, no advertising and no third-party script, and asks for no personal data to browse the catalog.

sections.heading: Hosting and security
paragraphs: Like any website, Sekoya Parts receives the IP address and headers your browser sends. Its host, Vercel, processes them to serve the pages and protect the site, and may keep them in its technical logs, under its own privacy policy.
Vercel’s firewall may check that your browser is not a bot, and then set a technical cookie that remembers this check.

sections.heading: Search
paragraphs: When you search for a part, the site’s server passes your search to Algolia, its search engine, hosted in Europe. Algolia does not receive your IP address: only an identifier the site derives from it with a secret key, used to limit the number of searches per visitor. Algolia’s analytics and personalization are turned off.

sections.heading: Recently viewed products
paragraphs: On a product page, your browser keeps the last 10 products you opened (their reference, name and address) in its local storage, to show them on the next product pages. This list never leaves your browser: the site does not receive it.
To clear it, use the “Clear history” button under the list, or delete this site’s data in your browser’s settings.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: Browsing the catalog sets no cookie of the site’s own.

When you add a part to the cart, the site sets a cookie, cart_v1, which holds only the products’ numbers and quantities. When you apply a promotion code, it sets a second one, promo_v1, which holds only that code. The site keeps each for 30 days after its last change. They are strictly necessary for the cart: that is why the site shows no consent banner.
To empty it, remove the parts on the cart page, or delete this site’s data in your browser’s settings.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification and erasure with the publisher, whose details are in the legal notice, and lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.description: The accessibility level Sekoya Parts aims for, what is checked, and the known limits.

sections.heading: Aim
paragraphs: Sekoya Parts aims for level AA of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

sections.heading: What is checked
paragraphs: On every code change, Lighthouse measures the accessibility of the main pages on mobile, and a change that would take it below 95 out of 100 is not published. A test also checks the contrast of every pair of colours on the site.

sections.heading: What helps
paragraphs: The catalog pages work without JavaScript. A skip link leads to the main content, and both the language switch and the search are standard HTML elements, usable with a keyboard.

sections.heading: Known limits
paragraphs: No full audit has been carried out. The “page not found” page stays blank until the page’s scripts have loaded, or when JavaScript is off, and shows in English for an unknown language.

sections.heading: Report a problem
paragraphs: If some content is not accessible to you, write to the publisher, whose details are in the legal notice.
